title: Nix work uses two non-overlapping minimal skills
description: An authored nix-workflow skill exists, but its terminal scope and missing rules have not been tested against recent Nix realization sessions. Mine recent sessions and psyche for repeated failures and settled directions, compare the current source and generated consumers, then revise only what prevents observed failures. The user explicitly requested design and implementation in Curriculum.
design: Treat recent raw session records, existing authored nix-workflow.md, psyche rulings, repository Nix instructions, and current public Nix guidance as evidence. Separate universal Nix workflow from repository-specific deployment data. Preserve brutal minimalism: add only non-derivable rules tied to observed failures; prefer one skill unless evidence shows non-overlapping triggers. Edit only Curriculum skills/*.md and manifests/*.dotos as required, regenerate consumer surfaces from the consumer workspace, validate, forward-test on context-minimal Nix tasks, commit and push.
acceptance_criteria: The proposal names the observed failures each retained or added line prevents; the authored skill and manifest are valid and minimal; generated consumers are regenerated from source rather than edited; repository checks and representative forward-tests pass; no setup-specific path/value is embedded; changes are committed and pushed; deployment evidence shows the active consumer receives the revised skill.
notes:
Evidence ruling for implementation: keep two non-overlapping triggers. nix-workflow owns ordinary Nix source/evaluation/build/activation discipline and gains central package-set customization against the exact final package set plus explicit witness states; it loses setup-specific repo names and the empty reproducible-source slogan. nix-input-upgrade is rewritten from inactive incident-heavy source into a minimal active workflow: dependency graph/final provider, producer pushed before consumer lock, verify fix by commit, scoped named-input update, contract pins, patch classification, interface recheck, retired-input pruning, and every-consumer evaluation. No third Nix skill; testing and operating-system retain their domains.
Producer pushed: Curriculum main 3de72cb136e4991c8993335574d464331bc5a267 rewrites nix-workflow, rewrites/activates nix-input-upgrade, and changes only the two authored skill files plus active-outputs/module-dependencies manifests. Disposable consumer generation/check/visualization and remote durable checks passed; forward tests selected ordinary workflow alone for package customization and both skills for a named lock update. Full gate has pre-existing fmt and role-cross-product failures. Remaining: independent wording audit and Primary lock/regeneration deployment.

title: Restore canonical skills corpus after reset
description: Manual post-reset restoration is not yet durable. The canonical skill sources live in /git/github.com/LiGoldragon/skills, while internal .agents and .claude copies are generated runtime surfaces. The restoration must reconcile source ownership, deployment instructions, and the universal worker contract before any deletion or recovery is landed. This bead records the authorized scope without editing skill files in the present audit.
design: Use one canonical copy in the skills repository as the source of truth. Remove internal .agents/.claude duplicates only as part of a verified deployment change. Correct edit-path instructions and deployment so agents edit the skills repository and generated surfaces are produced from it. Delete engine-analysis, working, and pi-extension-updates only after reachability and dependency checks. Recover version-control from old material. Individually review testing, feature-development, main-feature-integration, operating-system, versioning, context-handover, and repository-lifecycle. Move universal commit-and-push behavior to the universal worker contract. Keep every skill edit behind explicit psyche approval and run generation/checks before declaring the restoration complete.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical-copy audit identifies exactly one editable source for each retained skill in the skills repository. Internal .agents/.claude duplicates are removed or proven generated and no longer treated as edit targets. AGENTS and deployment instructions name the canonical edit path and verified generation path. engine-analysis, working, and pi-extension-updates are deleted only with a recorded reachability/dependency witness. version-control is recovered from old material and its resulting source is reviewed. testing, feature-development, main-feature-integration, operating-system, versioning, context-handover, and repository-lifecycle each have an individual review result recorded. Universal commit-and-push behavior is present in the universal worker contract rather than duplicated as an accidental local rule. Generation, repository checks, and affected runtime-surface verification pass. No skill is changed without explicit psyche approval.
notes:
User distinctions to preserve verbatim: one canonical copy in the skills repository; remove internal `.agents`/`.claude` duplicates; correct edit-path instructions/deployment; delete engine-analysis, working, and pi-extension-updates; recover version-control from old material; individually review testing, feature-development, main-feature-integration, operating-system, versioning, context-handover, and repository-lifecycle; move universal commit-and-push behavior to the universal worker contract. Present audit only creates this durable item and does not edit skill files.
New user ruling to preserve verbatim: rename WORKING_AGENTS.md to NON_MANAGEMENT_AGENTS.md; AGENTS.md should direct only non-management workers to it; management should not carry working/edit/deployment instructions. This updates the restoration scope; no skill or instruction file was edited in this update.
Landed canonical restoration slice in skills commit 7016d47b54eff5915938c2aaddf4eb3fd0feb767; main pushed and verified at origin. Includes internal generated-tree removal, retired skill deletion/manifests, explicit distinct-consumer generation guard, read-only source-checkout visualization, docs/tests, and version 0.5.0. Evidence: cargo test --offline --all-targets passed all 47 tests; nix flake check --no-build --no-write-lock-file evaluated all checks successfully. Known remaining failure: stale role-cross-product Nix assertion at flake.nix:293 was intentionally not changed. Bead remains open for manual skill restoration.
2026-08-10 primary integration: primary flake.lock now pins skills 7016d47b54eff5915938c2aaddf4eb3fd0feb767; flake generated-skills-current passes SKILLS_WORKSPACE_ROOT explicit-consumer wiring; remote generate-skills and check-skills passed; primary excludes caller-owned .lojix-bootstrap-primary-* directories with a root-anchored .gitignore rule and leaves their files unchanged. No private values were committed.

title: Curriculum formatting check agrees with generation tests
description: While validating skills-onp, the repository-wide Nix fmt check failed on pre-existing formatting drift in tests/generation.rs. Focused source, generation, visualization, and all 49 tests passed; this formatter failure is unrelated to the Nix skill changes but leaves the aggregate flake gate red.
design: Run the repository formatter on the exact reported test source, inspect the semantic diff, and land only the mechanical formatting correction if no behavior changes. Do not mix it with skill wording.
acceptance_criteria: The formatter produces no diff; the fmt Nix check passes through configured remote builders; generation tests still pass; the correction is committed and pushed.

title: Rename Spirit capture vocabulary from intent-log to spirit-log
description: The 2026-08-01 psyche ruling resolves the earlier naming failure: the computer representation of the psyche’s spirit is spirit, and every skill use of intent that denotes that Spirit-content becomes spirit. Ordinary intention remains available for what the psyche wants. The current skills/intent-log.md filename, id, description and manifest entries denote Spirit capture and must be ported through the LiGoldragon/skills sources. Related workspace umbrella: primary/primary-7z3. Existing primary/primary-25t is superseded.
design: Before any skill edit, present the exact proposed spirit-log source and manifest change to the psyche and obtain explicit approval. Edit only flat sources and manifests, then regenerate and validate every affected runtime surface; never edit generated copies. Audit semantically: retain ordinary phrases such as unresolved intent and design intent. Treat retired vocabulary strings used by migration or lint witnesses as historical exceptions unless their owning test policy is deliberately changed.
acceptance_criteria: After explicit psyche approval, spirit-log is the canonical source and manifest identity; active intent-log source and manifest entries are gone or have an explicitly approved compatibility disposition; all generated agent surfaces are regenerated from source and pass repository validation; active skill vocabulary uses spirit only for Spirit-content; ordinary intention and explicit historical witnesses remain; and the close reason cites the approval and validation evidence.

title: Stop injecting skills into role packets
description: Some skills are composed into generated role packets rather than being read as skills. The psyche does not want that unless the injection is specifically justified; he would rather tell agents to read the skill, since agents read skills anyway. Known injection surfaces: manifests/universal-role-modules.nota puts general-instructions and tenets into every generated role packet, and manifests/target-module-insertions.nota puts codex-skill-loading into general-instructions for Codex targets. Establish which injections earn their place and convert the rest to a read instruction. Relates to the ruling on skill dependencies, which chose declaration in the description over build-time composition for the same reason: composition duplicates text and hides where a rule comes from.

title: Parse the generator argument with the NOTA argument library
description: src/main.rs calls CommandLine::from_environment with no NOTA argument library visible at the entry point. The conversion to a single NOTA payload was reported as wrapping triad_runtime ComponentCommand inside CommandLine, which has not been confirmed at the call site. The goal is an entry point that takes its one NOTA argument through the shared library rather than through code this repository maintains. References: src/main.rs, src/assembly.rs CommandLine, orchestrate and spirit-judge entry points.

title: Pi role packets carry fields nothing reads
description: Generated Pi role packets include projectRoleIdentity and projectRoleDispatchKind, and no consumer of either exists anywhere in the Pi package. Core Pi also has no subagent surface, so the role packets themselves describe a capability Pi does not have. References: .pi/agents/*.md, Pi package docs usage.md line 308.

title: Correct tier over-selection
description: Agents consistently choose a larger tier than the work needs, including for fully specified changes. The descriptions were rewritten once and the pattern continued. References: manifests/role-descriptions.nota.

title: Give subagents a role name at launch
description: Beads record every actor as li, so the store cannot tell one agent from another or from the psyche. Codex already carries what is wanted: spawn_agent takes task_name, present in all 314 recorded calls, distinct from the tier and doubling as the address for send_message and interrupt_agent. Claude's Agent tool has no name parameter and mints its own opaque identifier. Core Pi has no subagent surface. An orchestrate lane already carries a unique LaneIdentifier and a Role, and refuses an empty role, but nothing links that to a harness launch. Setting BEADS_ACTOR at launch would differentiate every bead write with no schema change. References: manifests/role-descriptions.nota, signal-orchestrate/schema/lib.schema lines 50 to 62, bd --actor resolution order.

title: Enforce the read permission on Codex roles
description: Codex role packets carry no tool field, so a read role is restrained by prose alone while Claude and Pi enforce it structurally. References: src/assembly.rs line 452, .codex/agents/read-critical.toml.

title: Rule on the Claude critical depth
description: Codex and Pi critical run gpt-5.6-terra at xhigh. Claude critical runs claude-opus-5 at high. Whether the top depth sits at the ceiling in both columns is the psyche's call. References: manifests/role-depths.nota, manifests/model-catalog.nota.
close_reason: Integrated at 77b90aaeb22f: Claude critical and generated critical agents use exact claude-opus-4-6[1m] with High, preserving 1M context. Proof: cargo test --locked, isolated generate/check, nix flake check.

title: Ship the reviewed skill texts
description: New bodies for management, psyche-interraction, skill-designing, beads, context-handover and edit-coordination were settled with the psyche and none are in source. management restores a line removed without approval and reduces the Codex conditional to a single wait timeout. psyche-interraction goes from twenty lines to ten with both headings dropped. skill-designing goes to two lines. beads is three. context-handover gains that the handover is written once every subagent has returned and names its beads in the response. edit-coordination gains that bd commands need no claim. References: reports/BeadsDesign/SharedVision.md, skills/management.md, skills/psyche-interraction.md, skills/skill-designing.md, skills/context-handover.md, skills/edit-coordination.md.
notes:
Psyche rulings 2026-07-27. Corpus style, standing: a skill carries no heading naming the skill or the word Skill; a skill description lives in that skill file own frontmatter so it is readable where the skill is edited; no hyphen-space bullet prefixes, one directive per line as prose. Structure: bd usage lives in a new beads skill, not in work-tracking. work-tracking is replaced by working, a basic how-to-work skill for every agent except a manager who does not edit repositories, holding only: read the AGENTS.md of the repository you work in; check the beads before starting; close an item only with durable evidence. Rejected: the old gate Track work only when it must survive the session, because beads should be used as freely as agents want; and Give each item an outcome, proof, and dependencies, as vague and a repeat of the beads skill, since not everything has dependencies. The design log stays as it is: a log is a chronological record, distinct from a bead --design field, which is how one piece of work is to be done. Dead source files that reach no generated output are to be deleted.
Psyche ruling 2026-07-27: operating-system-operations is renamed operating-system and its contents discarded as garbage. It keeps one rule, that this is a declarative operating system changed by editing its declarative source, plus the failure that rule prevents. The skill names no repository so it stays usable by anyone running a declarative operating system; the source locations are a workspace variable added to /home/li/primary/AGENTS.md as CriomOS for the system and CriomOS-home for the user environment. Follow-up wanted: audit the docs in CriomOS and CriomOS-home for accuracy.
Psyche ruling 2026-07-27 on skill descriptions. A description names the situation that makes an agent load the skill: a trigger, not a topic. No shared opening formula; Use when was rejected as useless boilerplate paid for by every skill. Length is free, spent on what separates a skill from its neighbours. No two descriptions may match the same situation. Nothing in a description appears in the skill: the description is the situation before loading, the skill is what to do after, and this forbids a skill body from restating its own trigger. All 23 descriptions rewritten under this rule. tenets is deliberately exempt from the situation form because it always applies.
Psyche ruling from session a6a3b5bc, recovered 2026-07-27 after it was lost from the handover. Verbatim: "again, we are not *forcing* the agent to do that, we are *allowing* him". The management scope line must read as permission, not instruction. Settled form: You may read and write beads, reports, design documents, the design log, and skills. He rejected the intermediate patch Read and write only ... as still imperative. skills belongs in the list because he ruled the manager edits skills directly: "There is no need to put an agent between the manager and the skill editing, although he is going to need an agent to deploy them." Never block on subagents. was removed from management without his approval and must be restored. Root cause, verbatim: "I never said it has to be in the imperative style only. I said it has to be minimal, which often turns out to be the imperative style, but it is not the only minimal style. So is there a line somewhere that obliges imperative style that line should go, and it should be replaced with a more psyche-aligned statement, as I said it?" That line is Every line directs an action. in skill-designing. He also asked that the workspace AGENTS.md name where the manager-readable things live so the manager does not spend time hunting for them, which is primary-52h.

title: Retire target-module-insertions
description: Two records remain in the manifest and both can now be expressed as target conditionals, which removes the manifest and the class of decay it carries. References: manifests/target-module-insertions.nota, manifests/module-dependencies.nota.

title: Guard against template branches that never render
description: A target conditional whose branch renders for no target is doctrine nothing will ever find, and unlike an orphaned file it cannot be found by searching the tree. References: src/assembly.rs render_target, reports/SkillTemplateEngine/Design.md.

title: Prune role outputs the generator did not write
description: Role deletion diffs against an inventory of paths a previous run recorded emitting, so a role file that arrived any other way is never removed. Skill pruning has no such gap. References: src/assembly.rs RoleOutputInventory, skills/generated-role-outputs.nota.

title: Remove every source file that generates nothing
description: Twenty-eight of the fifty files in skills/ generate nothing. Thirteen are RoleComposition modules declared in module-dependencies.nota and consumed by nothing. Nine manager-* files and psyche-facing-commitments are referenced by no manifest and are held in place by a flake check that asserts each exists and stays out of the index. claude-manager-non-fable.md is referenced by nothing at all, including that check. The goal is a source tree where every file is reachable from generation, and the same sweep applied to dead code elsewhere in the repository. References: manifests/module-dependencies.nota, flake.nix line 323, skills/.

title: Review the five-skill dependency structure
description: psyche-vision and beads stand as bases; context-handover, work-tracking and psyche-interraction depend on them. No loader supports a requires field, so the dependency is prose an agent may act on at its discretion. The psyche has seen none of the drafted text. References: reports/BeadsDesign/SharedVision.md.
notes: Psyche ruling 2026-07-27: skill dependencies are declared in frontmatter and rendered into the skill description, so the dependency is visible at load-selection time and the generator can validate that the named skill exists. Chosen over build-time composition to stop corpus duplication; the cost accepted is that a declaration can be skipped where composition cannot. Blocked on the description-to-frontmatter migration landing first, since it is the same generator code path.
close_reason: Integrated at 77b90aaeb22f: source frontmatter owns dependencies; generator validates and surfaces them. Proof: cargo test --locked, isolated generate/check, nix flake check.

title: Define what psyche vision is
description: The psyche-vision skill explains what psyche vision is and how to pass it along. The defining sentence is still unwritten; four attempts were rejected. What is settled: vision is matter, so it routes to beads and the design log. References: skills/psyche-vision.md, reports/BeadsDesign/SharedVision.md, AGENTS.md Intent section.
notes:
Recovered 2026-07-27 from ~/.claude/projects/-home-li-primary/*.jsonl session transcripts. These are the psyche verbatim, recorded here because the file that was meant to hold them, reports/BeadsDesign/SharedVision.md, no longer exists and he has now had to raise this more than once.

Origin of the skill, session 7d725716 line 23: "we need a psyche-vision skill, so agents know what it means."

Vision against intent, session 7d725716 line 57: "no, intent is even more difficult to explain and much more rare than vision"

Session a6a3b5bc line 464: "vision is matter"

Session a6a3b5bc line 481, on what the skill is for: "its job is explaining what psyche vision is."

Session a6a3b5bc line 500, rejecting the deployed text, which had copied the AGENTS.md intent paragraph nearly word for word: "well firstly, intent shouldnt be explained in agents.md, and that is *not* what psyche vision is"

Session a6a3b5bc line 738, the closest thing to a positive definition: "I totally disagree; a handover is a working goal with context, just like the vision I have for a bead"

Session a6a3b5bc line 621, on what a bead carries: "So I want to be very strict about how they have to contain only the vision, the goal, the intention and a few references. Kind of like a context handover... They have something in common which is conveying a goal without, and some references to make it easier for the agent that will use it to find his bearings, but only at the most minimal. I really don't want the agent who picks up the work to be given instructions on how it should be done, because agents perform best when they're given sort of guidelines on how our standards basically."

Earlier handover, quoted in session a6a3b5bc line 8: "I don't want specific instructions, only the goal and vision, let the implementer re-situate the work. Things change too fast and a proper job needs dedicated, not divided attention."

Session a6a3b5bc line 902, the dependency structure, which also settles skills-kys: "no, I disagree with all the splitting. psyche vision is psyche vision. context-handover is context-handover, and work-tracking is work-tracking. but the latter depend on the first, and psyche-interraction should re-use psyche-vision as well. and we need a skill for beads."

What the deployed skill gets wrong. It defines vision as intent, using AGENTS.md's load-bearing will and aims, values, beliefs, priorities. It sets a test separating vision from matter when the psyche has ruled vision is matter. Its Not vision section therefore excludes the very thing vision is.
close_reason: Approved definition is now the only runtime body; generated surfaces are fresh and validation passed: check-skills, cargo test --all-targets (43 passed), and nix flake check.
